On 14 September 1959 at 5:10-15 in the morning three witnesses south of Sali (Algeria) were intrigued by the evolution of an orange-coloured luminous body in the sky. At 5:30 the object is stationary. For 40 minutes they find that the body slowly drifts towards the NE by frequently changing its appearance and colour (red at one end). Observation is done at the binoculars. No drags or noises were observed. The total time for observation will be approximately one hour. Another observation was noted on the report. It is described for 12 September 1959 at 7pm the observation of a phenomenon of orange colour and an apparent diameter of a star located at very high altitude and moving at high speed from 180° to 360° in about 30 seconds. No particular sound is noticed.

GEIPAN classification B: probably identified. Observation details: date 1959-09-14; location SALI. Provenance: source fr_cnes_geipan, record GEIPAN-57, reference https://www.cnes-geipan.fr/fr/cas/1959-09-00043.
fr: Original French account from GEIPAN:

Durant 40 minutes ils constatent que le corps dérive lentement vers le NE en changeant fréquemment d'aspect et de couleur (rouge à une extrémité). L'observation se fait aux jumelles. Aucune trainée et aucun bruit n'ont été constatés. L'observation durera environ une heure au total. Une autre observation est notée sur le rapport. Il est décrit pour le 12 septembre 1959 à 19h l'observation d'un phénomène de couleur orange et d'un diamètre apparent d'une étoile situé à très haute altitude et se déplaçant à grande vitesse de 180° à 360° en 30 secondes environ. Following a telephone call from the witness, the gendarmes moved home. The witness states that he has made a written report (handwritten report attached to the PV) on an observation made in the sky at an estimated altitude of 100 to 150 m approximately above the locality known as "Serre de Pieroulet" commons of Pranles (ATTENTION LA PHOTO gives another approximate location: "Chamarouan" district in PRANLES) The observed phenomenon is in an ovoidal, luminous form, centred in permanent by two perfectly circumscribed fireplaces and a particularly intense brightness. Around this light form a beam of bluish light was sweeping the surrounding area. Another very small and very weakly luminous eccentric point on a slightly lower plane than the one before is also observed. The observation lasted from 22:45 to 23:28.: the ovoid underwent an intense increase in light and then sudden extinction giving the impression of leaving at very high speed. The sky is suddenly becoming black again.

Autour de cette forme lumineuse fixe un faisceau de lumière bleuâtre balayait les alentours.
